jobs.title: Sports Program Grant Writer
jobs.description:
We fuel our athletes with equipment, data-driven coaching, and unstoppable confidence. From youth athletes to elite athletes, we drive performance that crushes expectations. Here at APEX Para Athletics you can expect to see training programs, and cutting-edge analytics that turn raw talent into game-day domination. Stop settling. Start winning.

Apex Para Athletics is an upcoming and pending 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to supporting para athletes in para-athletic development skill growth. Operating as a year-round program, we serve families and athletes across Minnesota and Independent/ Unattached para athletes, providing consistent opportunities to train, compete, and grow.

"Apex Para Athletics is one of the fastest-growing para athletic development programs in Minnesota."

Through regional partnerships, dedicated instructional facilities, and community contributions, we provide life-changing sport access to athletes of all background levels.

We emphasize teaching foundational values that serve our athletes both on the track and throughout their lives

Courage & Persistence
Honesty & Integrity
Responsibility & Loyalty

What We Provide

Elite High-Performance Coaching Specialized technical coaching and structured training pathways built specifically for competitive Para track &field, and multi-sport disciplines.
Refurbished Specialized Competition Equipment Supplying Refurbished high-performance adaptive gear and travel support to remove systemic barriers for dedicated athletes.
Developmental Pipelines Creating clear, structured pathways that elevate high school and college-aged athletes into post-secondary, collegiate, and professional para sports platforms.

,

Company Description
Apex Para Athletics is a nonprofit elite para-athletics development program focused on high-performance coaching and competition pathways for athletes with disabilities. The organization connects grassroots participation to collegiate, national, and Paralympic opportunities, creating clear routes for long-term athlete development. Apex Para Athletics supports athletes with specialized technology, expert coaching, and individualized training to help them reach peak performance. The program collaborates with partners and stakeholders across the sport and disability communities to expand access to competitive para-athletics. Team members contribute directly to building inclusive, high-performance environments for emerging and elite athletes.

Role Description
The Sports Program Grant Writer is a volunteer role responsible for securing funding to support Apex Para Athletics’ programs, athletes, and equipment needs. This hybrid role is based in the Greater Minneapolis–St. Paul Area, with a mix of on-site collaboration and work-from-home flexibility. Day-to-day tasks include identifying potential grant opportunities, conducting prospect research, and aligning funding priorities with organizational initiatives in para-athletics. The grant writer will prepare compelling proposals, letters of inquiry, and reports that clearly communicate program impact, budget needs, and performance outcomes. The role also involves maintaining a grants calendar, tracking deadlines, supporting grant administration, and collaborating with coaches, program staff, and leadership to gather data and success stories. Assisting Apex Para Athletics athletes in finding, securing, and obtaining individual grants to support their personal athletic development, equipment, and competition expenses. This position contributes to the sustainability and growth of para-athletics pathways by helping secure resources for coaching, competitions, and specialized technology.

Hiring Area of Focus
(1) Para Track & Field - Sports Program Grant Writer, (1) Para Wheelchair Basketball - Sports Program Grant Writer, (1) Para Ski & Snowboarding - Sports Program Grant Writer, (1) Para Strength & Conditioning - Sports Program Grant Writer, (1) Sports Program Grant Writer - Organization.

Reports To
Director of Marketing & Communications

Qualifications

Demonstrated skills in Grant Writing and Proposal Writing, with the ability to produce clear, persuasive, and well-structured funding requests.
Experience in Grant Administration, including tracking deadlines, managing application requirements, and supporting reporting and compliance.
Strength in Prospect Research and Fundraising, including identifying potential funders and aligning opportunities with program goals.
Skill in researching, guiding, and assisting individual athletes with finding and applying for dedicated adaptive sports grants.
Strong written communication, editing, and attention to detail, with the ability to tailor messaging to foundations, corporations, and individual donors.
Ability to synthesize program data, budgets, and impact metrics into concise narratives for grant applications and reports.
Comfort working in a hybrid environment in the Greater Minneapolis–St. Paul Area, collaborating with staff and volunteers both in person and remotely.
Interest in para-athletics, adaptive sports, or nonprofit program development; prior experience in sports, disability advocacy, or nonprofits is beneficial.
Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple deadlines and priorities; proficiency with basic productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, shared drives).

jobs.title: Per-Diem RN Service Supervisor — Home Care
jobs.description:
PER-DIEM RN SERVICE SUPERVISOR — HOME CARE
Cary • Raleigh • Apex • Morrisville, North Carolina
$42–$45/hour | W-2 | Per-Diem (PRN)
Blue Diamond Care is a North Carolina home care agency preparing for launch and seeking its first Per-Diem RN Service Supervisor — Home Care.
This professional nursing role supports the safe, consistent delivery of home care services through assessment, care planning, caregiver readiness and supervision, client follow-up, documentation, consultation, and collaboration with agency leadership.
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a bedside shift nursing position and is not a skilled home-health treatment role.
Instead, it is an opportunity for an experienced RN who values thoughtful home-care practice, independent professional judgment within defined authority, strong documentation, caregiver support, client safety, and high-quality service delivery.
The position offers the opportunity to help establish a well-organized home-care program while focusing on the professional responsibilities of the Service Supervisor role.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
As the Per-Diem RN Service Supervisor, you will:
• Conduct initial in-home assessments for clients receiving In-Home Aide / personal-care services.
• Evaluate functional and home-care needs within your professional authority and assigned responsibilities.
• Develop, approve, review, and update plans of care and service instructions consistent with agency policy and professional judgment.
• Evaluate caregiver competency and assignment readiness when required by the approved service model.
• Provide professional supervision, consultation, and support to caregivers providing In-Home Aide services.
• Serve as the designated supervisor for Companion/Sitter services under Blue Diamond Care's launch model.
• Conduct client and caregiver supervisory follow-up activities and document findings appropriately.
• Identify and escalate safety concerns, service concerns, changes in client needs, documentation issues, and scope-of-practice concerns.
• Communicate professionally with clients, families, caregivers, and the Agency Director, and coordinate with other involved providers when appropriate to the supervisory role.
• Maintain timely, accurate electronic documentation and required records.
• Support continuity of supervisory responsibilities through appropriate communication and handoff when availability changes.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Required Qualifications
To be considered for this position, applicants must have:
• Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse license or authority valid for practice in North Carolina.
• Minimum 2 years of professional RN experience.
• Graduate of an accredited nursing education program.
• Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Ability and willingness to perform in-home field responsibilities.
• Ability and willingness to travel throughout Cary, Raleigh, Apex, and Morrisville.
• Valid driver's license.
• Reliable transportation.
• Personal automobile insurance meeting applicable legal and agency requirements when using a personal vehicle for agency business.
• Ability to provide at least 10 hours of recurring weekday availability per week, reasonably distributed across weekday blocks that support agency operational needs.
• Ability to communicate professionally with clients, families, caregivers, and agency leadership.
• Ability to use electronic documentation and agency technology systems.
• Willingness to supervise both approved Blue Diamond Care service pathways within the boundaries of the Service Supervisor role.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Preferred experience may include:
• Home care
• Home health
• Private duty nursing
• Geriatrics
• Community nursing
• Case management
• In-home assessment
• Plan-of-care development or review
• Caregiver supervision
• Caregiver competency evaluation
• Charge nurse experience
• Preceptor experience
• Clinical lead experience
• Client and family communication in residential or community settings
• Independent field documentation
• Strong scope-of-practice recognition
• Comfort with technology
• Adaptability in a launch-stage environment
Prior Service Supervisor experience is welcome but not required. Prior home-health titles, hospital experience, or management titles are not required.
Experience conducting client assessments, developing or reviewing plans of care, supervising direct-care personnel, evaluating caregiver competency, and coaching staff is particularly valuable for this role.
SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY
This is a Per-Diem (PRN) opportunity.
Weekly work hours are not guaranteed and will vary based on client and agency needs.
Blue Diamond Care is seeking an RN who can provide approximately 10–15 hours of recurring weekday availability per week, with a minimum requirement of 10 recurring weekday hours. Specific availability blocks will be established collaboratively based on agency operational needs and the selected RN's availability.
Routine nights and weekends are not anticipated as part of the launch schedule.
This position does not require unrestricted standby availability or continuous on-call coverage.
COMPENSATION & FIELD SUPPORT
• $42–$45 per hour
• W-2 employee status
• Per-Diem (PRN) scheduling model
• Authorized compensable work is paid in accordance with Blue Diamond Care employment policies.
• Qualifying business mileage is reimbursed in accordance with agency policy.
• Field-support resources are provided as appropriate to the role.
READY TO APPLY?
Interested candidates may apply using a résumé and/or employment-platform profile.
Qualified applicants selected to move forward in the process will be invited to complete Blue Diamond Care's employment application and participate in a structured interview process.
Employment is contingent upon applicable pre-employment requirements, credential verification, and related employment conditions.
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
Blue Diamond Care is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

jobs.title: Complex Case Manager (RN or LPN) - Pasco or Hernando Counties
jobs.description:
This role will support multiple clinics across Pasco and Hernando Counties and candidates should reside in those counties.

About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 91, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

Our highest-risk patients deserve our highest level of coordination.

As our Complex Case Manager, you'll own the longitudinal clinical management of Greenbrook's most medically complex patients. You'll help identify patients at greatest risk, develop proactive care strategies, coordinate across their care teams, and ensure critical needs are addressed before they become acute problems.

This is far more than traditional case management. You'll help manage patients with multiple chronic conditions, identify gaps in care, address barriers to successful outcomes, and ensure that the action items identified through Greenbrook's clinical review processes are translated into meaningful patient care.

You'll become one of the most connected people in our care model, partnering closely with physicians, center managers, medical assistants, pharmacists, the Acute Care & Transitions team, specialists, and community partners to improve outcomes for the patients who need us most.

You'll report to our VP, Market Medical Director and work alongside physicians, center managers, medical assistants, and our broader care management team.

Location:
Greater Tampa Bay Area (travel between clinics and care settings on a daily basis)

What You’ll Do

Own Longitudinal Care for High-Risk Patients

Manage a defined population of Greenbrook's highest-risk and most medically complex patients.
Develop and maintain individualized care plans based on patients' clinical needs, utilization patterns, risks, and goals.
Proactively identify patients at risk for deterioration, avoidable utilization, or gaps in care.
Coordinate with physicians, clinic teams, specialists, pharmacists, and community resources to address barriers to optimal care.
Follow patients over time to ensure care plans are implemented and adjusted as their needs change.

Drive Proactive Care Management

Use clinical data, utilization trends, and patient information to prioritize outreach and intervention.
Identify recurring patterns or gaps that may contribute to avoidable ED visits, hospitalizations, or other poor outcomes.
Support patients with multiple chronic conditions and complex psychosocial needs.
Connect patients and families with appropriate community resources and support services.
Partner with the Acute Care & Transitions team when patients experience hospitalization, ED visits, or SNF stays to ensure continuity of the broader care plan.

Drive Accountability for High-Risk Patients

Own the action item lists generated during Panel Review and Burden of Disease (BoD) meetings.
Track progress, follow up relentlessly, and ensure critical patient care activities are completed on time.
Monitor whether care plans and interventions are producing the desired outcomes.
Use data and reporting to identify opportunities for improvement and prioritize the highest-impact work.
Escalate clinical or operational barriers to physicians and leadership when needed.

Build Strong Clinical Partnerships

Develop trusted relationships with physicians, clinic teams, specialists, pharmacists, community organizations, and other care partners.
Serve as a clinical resource and thought partner to clinic teams managing complex patients.
Collaborate with the Acute Care & Transitions Manager to ensure patients move seamlessly between acute care and longitudinal care management.
Help strengthen Greenbrook's overall approach to managing high-risk patients across the continuum.

What Success Looks Like

High-risk patients have clear, current, and actionable care plans.
Critical Panel Review and Burden of Disease action items are consistently completed.
High-risk patients receive proactive outreach before problems become acute.
Gaps in care, utilization patterns, and emerging risks are identified and addressed.
Strong collaboration exists between Complex Case Management, Acute Care & Transitions, physicians, and clinic teams.
Reduced avoidable utilization and improved outcomes among Greenbrook's highest-risk patients.
Physicians and clinic teams view you as a trusted partner in managing their most complex patients.

About You

You bring:

Active RN or LPN license.
3+ years of nursing, care management, or complex care coordination experience.
Experience in managed care, Medicare Advantage, or value-based primary care.
Strong clinical judgment and ability to assess complex patient needs.
Experience coordinating care across multiple providers and care settings.
Strong Excel skills and comfort using data to prioritize work and identify opportunities.
A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork.

You’ll Stand Out If You

Have case management experience, especially if you possess the CCM (Certified Case Manager).
Have experience supporting complex Medicare Advantage populations.
Have experience managing patients with multiple chronic conditions and/or significant social needs.
Have knowledge of local community resources and social determinants of health.
Thrive in highly autonomous roles where you build systems instead of waiting for direction.
Are exceptionally organized, proactive, and known for following through.
Build trust quickly with physicians, nurses, patients, and external partners.
Constantly think one step ahead to prevent problems before they happen.
Are bilingual in Spanish.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We’re not a volume-driven system, we’re accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We’re building more than a company, we’re building careers. As we expand, you’ll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

$100,000 base salary, based on experience and qualifications
Generous annual performance bonus
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
401(k) with company match

We believe in fair, equitable pay that reflects your experience and impact.

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Clinic Visit + Case Study interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Recognized as a technology leader, Sanmina Corporation provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, delivering superior quality and support to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) primarily in the communications networks, defense and aerospace, industrial and semiconductor systems, medical, multimedia, computing and storage, automotive and clean technology sectors. Sanmina Corporation has facilities strategically located in key regions throughout the world.

Program Manager

Program Manager is responsible for all aspects of a program at the site, serving as the site liaison between the company and the customer to ensure customer needs are met. Ensures all program-related decisions are guided by the terms and conditions of the customer’s contract. Understands all aspects required to launch a new program or order. Responsible for customer management and satisfaction, order management and delivery, revenue achievement, business issue resolution (A/R, E&O material issues, PPV, credit, RMA’s), and business development. Understands Sanmina-SCI offerings for vertical integration and directs customer appropriately towards additional or alternative Sanmina-SCI products or services.

Nature Of Duties

Associate Program Manager requirements of the position include, but are not limited to:

Manage the development and implementation process of the customer’s products and services involving departmental teams focused on the delivery of new or existing products.
Serves as liaison between the company and the client during a project ending with the installation and acceptance of capitalized equipment, enterprise software systems, or system integration or consulting projects/engagements.
Ensures customer satisfaction of information technology solutions by managing the details of overall project schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Ability to interact daily with customers and support departments while maintaining a professional productive relationship.
Research accounts daily to inform customer on the status of their product. Be prepared for questions that the customer may have and supply them with every option available.
Plan and direct schedules/forecasts. Maintain accurate backlog by Customer.
Perform a wide variety of tasks related to the support of customers’ requirements and solving problems while maintaining profitability and cost savings.
Interface frequently with manufacturing to assist in improving processes resulting in cost savings.
Monitor the project from purchase order initiation through delivery ensuring completion of the product on schedule and within budget constraints.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business/ Accounting /Finance
Minimum of 2 years of related work experience
Experience in the Electronics Manufacturing of PCBs and system level assemblies a plus.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to handle and solve multiple projects at once.
Must be effective in planning and prioritizing activities as needed to accomplish tasks in a timely manner based on customer needs.
Proven track record of negotiating contracts and prices.
Strong excel skills including VLookups is required

new_jobs.title: Complex Case Manager (RN or LPN) - Pasco or Hernando Counties
new_jobs.description:
This role will support multiple clinics across Pasco and Hernando Counties and candidates should reside in those counties.

About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 91, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

Our highest-risk patients deserve our highest level of coordination.

As our Complex Case Manager, you'll own the longitudinal clinical management of Greenbrook's most medically complex patients. You'll help identify patients at greatest risk, develop proactive care strategies, coordinate across their care teams, and ensure critical needs are addressed before they become acute problems.

This is far more than traditional case management. You'll help manage patients with multiple chronic conditions, identify gaps in care, address barriers to successful outcomes, and ensure that the action items identified through Greenbrook's clinical review processes are translated into meaningful patient care.

You'll become one of the most connected people in our care model, partnering closely with physicians, center managers, medical assistants, pharmacists, the Acute Care & Transitions team, specialists, and community partners to improve outcomes for the patients who need us most.

You'll report to our VP, Market Medical Director and work alongside physicians, center managers, medical assistants, and our broader care management team.

Location:
Greater Tampa Bay Area (travel between clinics and care settings on a daily basis)

What You’ll Do

Own Longitudinal Care for High-Risk Patients

Manage a defined population of Greenbrook's highest-risk and most medically complex patients.
Develop and maintain individualized care plans based on patients' clinical needs, utilization patterns, risks, and goals.
Proactively identify patients at risk for deterioration, avoidable utilization, or gaps in care.
Coordinate with physicians, clinic teams, specialists, pharmacists, and community resources to address barriers to optimal care.
Follow patients over time to ensure care plans are implemented and adjusted as their needs change.

Drive Proactive Care Management

Use clinical data, utilization trends, and patient information to prioritize outreach and intervention.
Identify recurring patterns or gaps that may contribute to avoidable ED visits, hospitalizations, or other poor outcomes.
Support patients with multiple chronic conditions and complex psychosocial needs.
Connect patients and families with appropriate community resources and support services.
Partner with the Acute Care & Transitions team when patients experience hospitalization, ED visits, or SNF stays to ensure continuity of the broader care plan.

Drive Accountability for High-Risk Patients

Own the action item lists generated during Panel Review and Burden of Disease (BoD) meetings.
Track progress, follow up relentlessly, and ensure critical patient care activities are completed on time.
Monitor whether care plans and interventions are producing the desired outcomes.
Use data and reporting to identify opportunities for improvement and prioritize the highest-impact work.
Escalate clinical or operational barriers to physicians and leadership when needed.

Build Strong Clinical Partnerships

Develop trusted relationships with physicians, clinic teams, specialists, pharmacists, community organizations, and other care partners.
Serve as a clinical resource and thought partner to clinic teams managing complex patients.
Collaborate with the Acute Care & Transitions Manager to ensure patients move seamlessly between acute care and longitudinal care management.
Help strengthen Greenbrook's overall approach to managing high-risk patients across the continuum.

What Success Looks Like

High-risk patients have clear, current, and actionable care plans.
Critical Panel Review and Burden of Disease action items are consistently completed.
High-risk patients receive proactive outreach before problems become acute.
Gaps in care, utilization patterns, and emerging risks are identified and addressed.
Strong collaboration exists between Complex Case Management, Acute Care & Transitions, physicians, and clinic teams.
Reduced avoidable utilization and improved outcomes among Greenbrook's highest-risk patients.
Physicians and clinic teams view you as a trusted partner in managing their most complex patients.

About You

You bring:

Active RN or LPN license.
3+ years of nursing, care management, or complex care coordination experience.
Experience in managed care, Medicare Advantage, or value-based primary care.
Strong clinical judgment and ability to assess complex patient needs.
Experience coordinating care across multiple providers and care settings.
Strong Excel skills and comfort using data to prioritize work and identify opportunities.
A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork.

You’ll Stand Out If You

Have case management experience, especially if you possess the CCM (Certified Case Manager).
Have experience supporting complex Medicare Advantage populations.
Have experience managing patients with multiple chronic conditions and/or significant social needs.
Have knowledge of local community resources and social determinants of health.
Thrive in highly autonomous roles where you build systems instead of waiting for direction.
Are exceptionally organized, proactive, and known for following through.
Build trust quickly with physicians, nurses, patients, and external partners.
Constantly think one step ahead to prevent problems before they happen.
Are bilingual in Spanish.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We’re not a volume-driven system, we’re accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We’re building more than a company, we’re building careers. As we expand, you’ll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

$100,000 base salary, based on experience and qualifications
Generous annual performance bonus
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
401(k) with company match

We believe in fair, equitable pay that reflects your experience and impact.

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Clinic Visit + Case Study interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Program Manager

Program Manager is responsible for all aspects of a program at the site, serving as the site liaison between the company and the customer to ensure customer needs are met. Ensures all program-related decisions are guided by the terms and conditions of the customer’s contract. Understands all aspects required to launch a new program or order. Manage the development and implementation process of the customer’s products and services involving departmental teams focused on the delivery of new or existing products.
Serves as liaison between the company and the client during a project ending with the installation and acceptance of capitalized equipment, enterprise software systems, or system integration or consulting projects/engagements.
Ensures customer satisfaction of information technology solutions by managing the details of overall project schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Ability to interact daily with customers and support departments while maintaining a professional productive relationship.
Research accounts daily to inform customer on the status of their product. Be prepared for questions that the customer may have and supply them with every option available.
Plan and direct schedules/forecasts. Maintain accurate backlog by Customer.
Perform a wide variety of tasks related to the support of customers’ requirements and solving problems while maintaining profitability and cost savings.
Interface frequently with manufacturing to assist in improving processes resulting in cost savings.
Monitor the project from purchase order initiation through delivery ensuring completion of the product on schedule and within budget constraints.

Bachelor's degree in Business/ Accounting /Finance
Minimum of 2 years of related work experience
Experience in the Electronics Manufacturing of PCBs and system level assemblies a plus.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to handle and solve multiple projects at once.
Must be effective in planning and prioritizing activities as needed to accomplish tasks in a timely manner based on customer needs.
Proven track record of negotiating contracts and prices.
Strong excel skills including VLookups is required
